kjv: how is it that ye (the disciples) have no faith?
mine: Have you (the disciples) still no faith?
note: TR "pos ouk echete pistin" against "oupo echete pistin" ("not yet/still not") in Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.

kjv: to know the mystery of the kingdom of God
mine: the secret of the kingdom of God
note: mysterion is a revealed secret (God's hidden plan now disclosed), not something mysterious or unknowable as "mystery" now suggests; TR also adds "gnonai" ("to know") from Matthew/Luke.
